name: Ranma 1/2 - Hiryuu Densetsu
source:
In this game, the player takes the role of Ranma as he/she interacts with situations and characters via on-screen icons, only occasionally involving combat by using a multiple-option interface.

[from Wikipedia]
translation:
本作中，玩家扮演乱马，通过画面上的图标与各种情境和人物互动；游戏偶尔也会进入战斗，并采用多选项界面进行操作。

[摘自Wikipedia]
